<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="finalized" xml:id="ex03012023-07-1009-06-03">de yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsa ba</rs> ltar na <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5611">'bum</rs> lasogs pa ni legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyis gsungs pa yin la | <rs type="school">phyi rol pa dag</rs> sgra tshad mar <lb edRef="inst:5892" n="3b7"/> byed cing <note type="gloss">sgra don la 'brel pa 'dod</note> don ngan pa yang sgra bzang pos bstan na mchog yin no zhes de la mngon par zhen pa dgag cing ston pa po tshad mar gyur pa'i skyes bus don tshad mas 'thad na sgra ngan na yang gnod pa med do zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:5633">mdo' 'di</rs>'i skad rnam pa bzhis gsungs pa yin ste | legs par sbyar ba'i skad dang | pra gi ta'i skad dang | a ba braM shi ta'i skad dang | be sha tse'i skad do || 
            de la dang po ni sang kri <lb edRef="inst:5892" n="3b8"/> ta'i skad do || 
            gnyis pa ni 'phral skad do ||
            gsum pa ni skad zur chag pa ste gdol pa'i skad do || 
            bzhi pa ni mi ma yin gyi skad do || 
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7040">su na ya shri</rs> ni legs par sbyar ba dang | de ma yin pa <note type="gloss">a be</note> gnyis kyis gsungs pa yin no zhes zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
